scope: Internal candidate-selection recommendation, not a frozen roster, launch authorization, complete registered interpretation or physical validation. No simulations or execution-source edits performed.

analysis.coverage: All 24 completed October 11 history rows and six same-producer source statics. Every event geometry reconstructed, 18 scientific source prefixes checked equal. Six histories from -14.4 at fraction .1 still need their retained October 10 experimental static prefix checks before full registered interpretation.
limits: Each direction/fraction uses one common elapsed physical post-event duration across its six rows; different fractions have different durations and cannot be directly contrasted as one common-time forcing experiment.
Equal later axial increments do not establish absent memory: lateral and occupancy increments still differ.
Counts are attached occupancy, not mass. Layers and narrow structural differences are discrete-grid observations.

The triage script retained existing readout definitions and bounded physical endpoints to final retained time to avoid subtraction/addition roundoff past trajectory end. Original first calculation refused that slight floating overshoot; no input was changed.

shared.unchanged: Existing aggregate-v6, monopole-matched hexPrism, residual/divergence tolerances 1e-9/1e-7, 200000 relaxation sweeps, one ordinary event only, supersaturation phase6SigmaWaterFromTable(T)*fraction at each environment. No facet/history hybrid. Finite target; checkpoint every completed update; no wall deadline.

recommendedBlocks.name: History timestep sensitivity
recommendedBlocks.question: Do the observed later-window equalization and cooling stage contrasts persist with smaller interface updates?
recommendedBlocks.controls: Reuse 24 October 11 CFL .05 histories after source parity. Source-static prefix checks before comparing new static responses; retain experimental labels for reused October 10 both/neither source controls. Compare same time across timestep variants, with bracket sensitivity and early/later windows. This is timestep sensitivity, not continuum or grid convergence.
recommendedBlocks.cost: Ordinary history measured costs available from parent operational analysis. Roughly doubled update counts are plausible but duration does not transfer exactly; runtime must be estimated from mature analogue cases, stated uncertain, and included in whole queue cost.

recommendedBlocks.name: Pressure and history interaction
recommendedBlocks.question: Does changing diffusion through constant pressure preserve or change the history-dependent incremental response?
recommendedBlocks.motivation: Completed supplement already answers the rejected static pressure timestep question: at f .10 low/high occupancy3747/4229 versus3759/4229 at old CFL; at f .20 low/high3583/2799 versus3607/2787. Both endpoint orderings survive tested timestep, but trajectories differ at common age. A new history interaction asks a distinct question about incremental growth; it is not another static occupancy grid.
recommendedBlocks.controls: New internally matched ordinary source statics at each pressure. Reuse existing 1-atm histories only after source parity. Across pressures compare on one common post-event physical-time window over the named comparison set; separate longer within-pressure windows. Pressure, inherited geometry, partial fill and vapor remain coupled; no isolated physical mechanism claim.

recommendedBlocks.name: History away from the original temperature pair
recommendedBlocks.question: Is the history lead confined to -6/-14.4 or also present at flank temperature pairs?
recommendedBlocks.controls: Internally matched early/late and ordinary preparations with source static prefixes. Do not infer which changed temperature caused a cross-pair difference. Bounded grep found no matching exact named history patterns in current roster sources; parent should perform final canonical duplicate census. Retained static reuse is optional only after source/observation compatibility.

rejected: No larger domain or finer grid in this selection: warm runs already expose mature-cost uncertainty, and these history questions have useful N64 contrasts.
No independent static pressure sweep merely to fill time; use the interaction block only if selected for that stated new question.
No new multi-event timeline, facet/history hybrid, scheduler, observer or verifier.
Do not pad a two-day queue with duplicate deterministic conditions or promise an exact finish time.
